question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Erudite
solution:
The correct answer is: **Scholarly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Erudite **means having or showing extensive knowledge acquired through reading and study.

 
 
• **For example-** *The professor's erudite lecture on ancient civilizations was well-received by the students.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Scholarly **means having knowledge gained through academic study and research.
 
 
• **For example-** *It is good to have this learned and scholarly life back in circulation.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that 'Scholarly' is the most appropriate **synonym **for 'Erudite.'

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of the other options.

 
 
• **Effervescent**: Enthusiastic and full of energy. (उत्‍साहपूर्ण और ऊर्जान्वित)
 
• **Energetic**: Full of or needing energy and enthusiasm. (शक्ति व उमंग संपन्‍न, ऊर्जायुक्त, कर्मठ)
 
• **Serene**: Calm and peaceful. (शांत और अविक्षुब्‍ध या गंभीर)
